pages.title: Bert Rudge
body: Took a high-school team all the way to the national championship, did you? Very impressive.

pages.title: The books bite
body: This is a REAL professional team. Players earn wages every week, whether they played like champions or garden furniture.
Contracts, facilities and the rest can wait until they matter. For now, keep one eye on the money at the top.

pages.title: Know your doors
body: These are the only doors you need today. I'll explain the machinery behind them when it can actually hurt us.

pages.title: Read it first
body: Honestly all you gotta look at is your inbox. I'll have all your to do's ready to go every week. Maybe I should get a salary too, eh?

pages.title: One player. One drill.
body: Choose a player, assign a drill, then run the session. Training costs TP and money, so don't scatter it around because a button looks cheerful.

pages.title: That's your week
body: Just remember to check your inbox to know what to do.
